9.en: Wet floors are a safety hazard, so please walk slowly.
9.zh: 湿滑地面有安全隐患，请慢行。

11.en: Both teams have a lot at stake in the final game.
11.zh: 两支队伍在决赛中都有很大的利害关系。

15.en: The phone's battery can hold only a small current.
15.zh: 这部手机的电池只能通过较小的电流。

18.en: We signed a one-year lease for the apartment.
18.zh: 我们签了一年的公寓租约。

22.en: The town entered a new era when the railway opened.
22.zh: 铁路开通后，这座小镇进入了一个新时代。

23.en: Check the website for the most up-to-date bus times.
23.zh: 请上网站查看最新的公交时刻。

27.en: The museum shows contemporary art from around the world.
27.zh: 这家博物馆展出来自世界各地的当代艺术。

29.en: The shop offers temporary jobs during the holiday season.
29.zh: 这家商店在假期期间提供临时工作。

35.en: Numerous families use this park on weekends.
35.zh: 许多家庭周末都会来这个公园。

41.en: When the bus stopped running, we resorted to taking a taxi.
41.zh: 公交停运后，我们只好改乘出租车。

47.en: A clear rule should prevail in every classroom: listen when others speak.
47.zh: 每间教室都应遵循一条明确规则：别人发言时认真听。

52.en: The personnel office can help you update your work records.
52.zh: 人事部门可以帮你更新工作档案。

56.en: The program is designed for adolescents who are learning to cook.
56.zh: 这个项目是为正在学习烹饪的青少年设计的。

60.en: Many families immigrate to find work and build a safer life.
60.zh: 许多家庭移民是为了寻找工作、过上更安稳的生活。

61.en: Her grandparents emigrated from Italy in the 1950s.
61.zh: 她的祖父母在20世纪50年代从意大利移居国外。
